versions.heading: Failure of Clerk to Transmit, or Loss of, Record – Proceedings
versions.text: Failure of the clerk to transmit the papers or transcript, or the loss of the same, shall not operate as a discontinuance of the civil action but copies may be furnished and filed.
versions.source: Perplexity cached copy of the courts.mo.gov page (pplx_sdk.content.fetch)

note: Prior rule texts are not published on courts.mo.gov rule pages; the chronology comes from the Court's history note.
